name: ph-withholding
description: Philippine creditable and final withholding tax for 2026, centred on resident professional fees. Determines the payee’s status, annual income, VAT registration, declaration and correct ATC before applying the 5%, 10% or 15% professional-fee rate. Covers other common resident EWT payments, certificates, gross-income reporting and tax credits, monthly and quarterly remittances, annual information returns, and current invoice disclosure. Distinguishes final passive-income tax from ordinary income-tax credits, including the CMEPA changes to deposits and shares. Use for a payer preparing a withholding payment or a professional reconciling Form 2307. Penalties require taxpayer-size and offence classification; nonresident payments, treaties, payroll and specialised transactions need their separate rules before a final filing position.
